SELECT id, spu_id, sku_code, name, spec_json, image, price, status FROM sku WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT s.id, s.spu_id, p.name AS spu_name, s.name, s.spec_json, s.image, s.price, s.status FROM sku s LEFT JOIN spu p ON p.id = s.spu_id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND s.id IN #{id}
